translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 4.3.2020 (radio)
Finnair plans to lay off its whole staff. Italy is closing schools because of the coronavirus. Joe Biden has done best in the Democratic primaries. Driving conditions are poor.
## Finnair plans to lay off all of its staff
![ Captain and first officer in the cockpit of a Finnair aircraft.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11240452)
Open image viewer
Because of the effects of the coronavirus, Finnair started change negotiations concerning its long-haul pilots in mid-February. Photo: Roni Rekomaa / Lehtikuva
Finnair may lay off all of its employees. Finnair will decide on the layoffs in the change negotiations.
Finnair has more than 6,000 employees in Finland. A layoff lasts 2 weeks or 4 weeks. A layoff means that work and pay stop temporarily.

Finnair has cancelled many flights because of the coronavirus. For example, Finnair has cancelled all flights to China until the end of April. Finnair is also cancelling flights to Japan, South Korea and Milan in Italy.
## Italy closes schools because of the coronavirus

![A woman wearing a protective face mask talks to a guard in front of a school closed because of the coronavirus in Padua, Italy.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11241019)
Open image viewer
A woman wearing a protective face mask talks to a guard in front of a school closed because of the coronavirus in Padua, Italy. Photo: Nicola Fossella / EPA

Italy is closing all schools and universities until the middle of March. The decision was reported by the Italian news agency Ansa. Ansa says that the schools will be closed until the end of next week.
There have been many coronavirus cases in Italy. More than 2,500 infections have been found, and 79 people have died. Most of the dead lived in Northern Italy, near the city of Milan.
THL estimates that all of Italy is an epidemic area. The Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs says that it is not worth travelling to Northern Italy unless the trip is important.
In total about 93,000 coronavirus infections have been found in the world.
## Joe Biden won in 9 states
![Joe Biden's supporters celebrating in Los Angeles.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11239879)
Open image viewer
Joe Biden's supporters celebrating in Los Angeles. Photo: AOP
In the USA, former vice president Joe Biden has done best in the Democratic primaries.
The primaries were held on Tuesday in 14 states. Biden won the primaries in 9 states. Senator Bernie Sanders won in 4 states.
The Democratic presidential candidate will probably be either Biden or Sanders. The Republican candidate is quite certainly President Donald Trump.
The US presidential election is in November.
## Driving conditions are poor
![Snowstorm and slushy roads make traffic difficult today in a large part of the country.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11241124)
Open image viewer
Snowstorm and slushy roads make traffic difficult. Photo: Emmi Korhonen / Lehtikuva
Driving conditions are poor across the whole country. The Finnish Meteorological Institute says that driving conditions are very poor in Uusimaa, Kymenlaakso and South Karelia.
A lot of snow or sleet is falling and the wind is strong. The roads are slippery. In the Helsinki area, for example, many accidents have happened.
Finnair has cancelled flights because of the bad weather. Some flights are late compared with the timetable.
On Thursday snow and sleet will fall in many places in Lapland, Kainuu and the eastern part of the country.
